$comment: Membership definitions follow https://data.igvf.org/documents/ddaf9ce5-471e-4cec-b344-c1071c0362b1/ Regulation fields originate from https://data.igvf.org/documents/c24cf62b-4e4e-45bb-80bf-dc9c0f99a0f4/; that linked document returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-26 and its definitions have not been reverified. This is a catalog edge schema, not the complete source-file schema.

_key.description: Membership keys contain the defining file, program, gene, and membership suffix. Regulation keys also contain the regulator result file, preserving separate conditions and experiments.

_from.description: Catalog gene referenced by the source gene column: an Ensembl identifier using the specification's IGVF GENCODE v43 annotation.

_to.description: Catalog program referenced by the source program_id, scoped to the associated defining gene-program file.

score.title: Score
score.description: Method-derived score or loading for a gene in the program. A positive score denotes a positive gene-program relationship; a negative score denotes an inverse relationship.

genomic_elements.title: Genomic Elements
genomic_elements.description: Targeted promoter intervals associated with this gene-level perturbation result. Multiple intervals share one reported effect; they are not separate independent tests.

log2FC.title: Log2 Fold Change
log2FC.description: Submitted log2 fold change of mean program score in perturbed cells versus the reference group. Sign describes the perturbation effect, not an inferred direction of gene regulation.

test_statistic.title: Test Statistic
test_statistic.description: Submitted test statistic for the difference in program scores between perturbed and reference cells.

neg_log10_pvalue.title: Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue.description: Submitted p_nominal_nlog10, retained without clipping or transformation; null when unavailable.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.title: Adjusted Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Submitted fdr_nlog10, the negative log10 of the multiple-testing-adjusted p-value or q-value.

reference_group.title: Reference Group
reference_group.description: Submitted description of the control/reference group used to calculate the perturbation effect.

significant.title: Significant?
significant.description: Whether the adjusted p-value or q-value is below 0.05 (fdr_nlog10 > -log10(0.05)); null when unavailable.
